transcript.message: Hello, I am an AI assistant from DoctorNearMe, not a doctor. I help your provider prepare for the visit. This call is recorded and summarised for your provider. Is it okay to continue?
Thank you. What is the main reason for this visit?
My daughter has pain in her right knee after football practice, for about three weeks now.
How did it start, and has it changed since?
She twisted it during a match. The swelling went down but the pain comes back when she runs or climbs stairs.
Has she had any treatment for it so far?
We used an ice pack and our family doctor said to rest for a week.
Does she take any medicines now?
Only paracetamol syrup 5 ml when the pain is bad, maybe twice a week.
She is allergic to peanuts, she gets hives.
What worries you most right now?
That she will stop playing sports, and that she limps after school some days.
Is there anything you would like to ask the provider at the visit?
When can she go back to football, and are there exercises we can do at home?
Thank you. In short: knee pain for three weeks after a twist, paracetamol when needed and a peanut allergy. Your provider will see you at the visit. Goodbye.

consent_given.rationale: The parent agreed at the start.
